sources.title: Java local-variable @SuppressWarnings
sources.version_or_date: Java Platform SE 6 API; Since 1.5; site footer 2015
sources.sections_read: Annotation target, retention, suppression inheritance, value semantics, Since field.
sources.confirmed: SuppressWarnings permits LOCAL_VARIABLE, uses source retention, and combines suppression sets through enclosing annotated elements; unknown warning names are ignored.
sources.limits: It does not annotate arbitrary blocks; it adds suppressions to inherited ones and does not implement conditional compilation. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C16.json.

sources.title: D conditional statements and declarations
sources.sections_read: ConditionalDeclaration and ConditionalStatement grammar; Version Condition.
sources.confirmed: D selects declarations or statements at compile time using version/debug/static-if conditions; nested conditionals need not introduce a scope, and excluded branches must still parse.
sources.limits: Unselected branches must still parse, conditional braces do not create scope, and this is not general-purpose audit metadata. sources.title: GCC diagnostic push/pop
sources.confirmed: GCC 4.7.0 documents source-location-sensitive diagnostic settings with push/pop restoration and an example suppressing one call between unsuppressed neighboring calls.
sources.limits: The region follows source locations rather than block structure; restoration is explicit, and only supported diagnostics are controllable. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C16.json.

sources.version_or_date: Nimrod v0.9.4 source-tag manual; release dated 2014-04-21

sources.title: C# unsafe and checked/unchecked block contexts
sources.sections_read: Cover; 27.1 Unsafe contexts and unsafe-statement grammar; 15.11 checked/unchecked statements; 14.5.13 checked/unchecked expression context.
sources.confirmed: The 2006 specification permits unsafe block statements and block-local overflow-checking contexts; these give lexical regions different permissions or checking semantics.
sources.limits: These are built-in semantic contexts, not an extensible annotation system or proof of safety; declaration metadata needs a separate mechanism. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C16.json.

sources.title: C++11/N3337 attributes on statements and declarations
sources.sections_read: Clause 6 statement grammar; 6.3 compound statements; 6.7 declaration statements.
sources.confirmed: N3337 permits attributes before compound statements and says they belong to the statement; its declaration statements introduce block-local names.
sources.limits: Placement alone provides no lint, audit, or conditional-compilation semantics; attribute applicability must be defined and nonstandard behavior is implementation-defined. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C16.json.

sources.confirmed: N3337 has an attribute-bearing simple-declaration production; its attributes attach to declared entities, invalid targets are ill-formed, and nonstandard attribute behavior is implementation-defined.
